## Checked before pushing

This repo is public. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/fueled-io/os-claude-advanced-training/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).

- [ ] No client or customer names, details, or anything that identifies one
- [ ] No real business numbers (revenue, pricing, pipeline, salaries)
- [ ] No personal information, passwords, API keys, or tokens
- [ ] No internal links or screenshots
- [ ] Nothing from `raw/`, `derived/`, or `outputs/history/`
- [ ] Anything in `golden/` is made-up data
